title: Off-by-One Loop Bounds
pattern_description: Iterating up to `<= array.length` or setting incorrect array termination bounds leading to Out-Of-Bounds exceptions.
rule: 0-indexed arrays run from `0` to `length - 1`. Iterating to `<= length` reads outside valid memory allocated for the container.
recommendation: Use strict inequality `< length` or range-based loops to eliminate boundary indexing errors.

title: Unbounded / Unchecked Mutation Inside Loops
pattern_description: Modifying loop index counters manually inside `for` loops or altering collection structure while iterating.
rule: Mutating loop index state in multiple places leads to skipped elements, infinite execution loops, or ConcurrentModificationExceptions.
recommendation: Decouple iteration logic from state mutation or create a filtered copy of the array.

title: Missing Base Case in Recursion
pattern_description: Recursive function calls without strict terminating condition resulting in Stack Overflow.
rule: Every recursive call path must converge towards a base case that returns without making further self-invocations.
recommendation: Validate base conditions (`n <= 0`, empty tree node, etc.) at the very top of recursive functions.

title: Unchecked Null / Pointer / Empty Access
pattern_description: Dereferencing pointers or accessing index 0 of empty arrays without checking size first.
rule: Calling properties or elements on null/empty data structures causes runtime crashes (NullPointerException, Segmentation Fault).
recommendation: Add explicit initial size or null check `if (vec.empty()) return 0;` at start of routine.
